hints.title: Pairwise Modulo Reduction
hints.text: Simulate the reduction step by replacing adjacent digit pairs with their sum modulo 10.

hints.title: Sequential Shrinkage
hints.text: Each round shrinks the length of the string by exactly one.

hints.title: Terminal Two-Digit Equality
hints.text: Stop when the length reaches 2 and check if both digits are identical.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Simulates adjacent pairwise additions modulo 10 across n - 2 rounds.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: n is small (up to 100), so O(n^2) simulation executes smoothly within milliseconds.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct in-place array updates eliminate excess string allocation overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Write clear iterative simulation with modulo 10 arithmetic.
